The Bash tool was disabled in this session, so I worked the totals out by hand rather than running a script. I did not verify the file with a script.

Decisions that affect the result:
- **Split payment:** the 999.00 payment referencing INV-0004 and INV-0011 pays INV-0004 its full 329.69 and sends the remaining 669.31 to INV-0011, which leaves 120.70 open.
- **Unmatched payments ignored:** the two "overschrijving zonder referentie" payments (437.66 and 297.97) have no invoice reference, so INV-0008 and INV-0020 stay fully open. The INV-0098 payment (120.00) names no existing invoice and is also ignored.
- **Overpayment:** INV-0022 received 277.04 against 272.04, so it is closed and the 5.00 excess is not carried anywhere.
